asr_text: But the jumps were not the only thing worth watching. In the experiment, the island and the conversation were reset every hour, but the work area where the AI kept notes and programs was carried over. The island went back to how it was before, but what the AI had discovered was not erased. So would that experience help the AI the next time it was called on? The researchers compared 13 AIs that had experience on the island with 13 AIs that had the same setup, but no such experience. On a new island, the challenge was to build as many towers as possible, each five blocks high in one hour. When the researchers looked at whether the AIs could build more than two, the experienced group did better. The ones that had taken a detour were now one step ahead.
